scope_zh_tw: 本政策只決定公開再散布；固定 canonical 原始來源保留。描述性品牌文字不等於品牌圖形授權，開放授權不自動清除商標、肖像或隱私權。
scope_en: This policy controls public redistribution only; fixed canonical originals remain private. Descriptive brand text is distinct from graphic rights. Open licenses do not automatically clear trademark, likeness or privacy rights.

local_media_exclusion_20261002.reason_zh_tw: 固定來源的軟體授權未提供這些嵌入圖片與品牌圖形獨立再散布依據，公開版本排除相關項目，canonical 原件保留。
local_media_exclusion_20261002.reason_en: The fixed source software licenses do not provide independent redistribution evidence for these embedded images and brand graphics. Related entries are excluded from publication; canonical originals are retained.
